items.question: How do I schedule a consultation?
items.answer: You can fill out our contact form, call us, or email us. We offer a free 30-minute initial consultation for new clients.

items.question: What are your fee structures?
items.answer: We offer various arrangements including fixed fees, hourly rates, and retainer agreements. Fees are discussed transparently at the initial consultation.

items.question: Do you handle cases outside your city?
items.answer: Yes, our attorneys are enrolled in multiple High Courts and can handle cases across India. We also offer virtual consultations.

items.question: How long does a typical case take?
items.answer: Timelines vary based on case complexity and court schedules. We provide realistic timelines at the outset and keep you updated throughout.
